title: AC1021 AutoCAD 2007 TABLE alignment cursor and LibreDWG screen
scope: Refine the existing P5-I raw-RS versus BitShort conflict with source-bound parser cursor observations and a read-only LibreDWG screen. This does not establish independent wire spans or TABLE-to-FIELD links.

source.producer: AutoCAD 2007, per the existing source-attribution receipt
source.fixtureDisposition: The exact file was read from the existing local sample inventory. No DWG/DXF fixture was added or changed in the repository.

alignmentCursorTrace.method: Temporary DRW_DBG cursor markers around the existing bounded TABLE parser. Instrumentation was removed from src/drw_entities.cpp after capture; the tracked code was not changed by this diagnostic.
alignmentCursorTrace.observation: The parser's BitShort candidate consumes 10 bits from the recorded alignment start; the ODA-specified raw RS consumes 16 bits, a six-bit difference. Under the candidate cursor the next BL and CadValue parse to expected strings and typed metadata.
alignmentCursorTrace.limitation: These are offsets from libdxfrw's own parser cursor, not independently extracted source-field spans. Candidate-path decoding and expected text do not prove the BitShort wire layout. ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.96.1 remains the authority for RS unless a version-qualified primary/source-bound witness establishes the actual boundary.

libreDwgPeerScreen.result: LibreDWG emits both ACAD_TABLE entities but leaves their cell data in unknown_bits and exposes no cell alignment or TABLE-to-FIELD links. The FIELD/FIELDLIST counts and owner graph do not qualify P5-A. Its local source at commit 6d6a33987a1a97095b069c799c3d8a793320f812 declares the alignment as SUB_FIELD_RS in src/dwg2.spec, but that source profile does not decode these records.

disposition.P5I: OPEN; preserve semantically incomplete cells and anonymous-block fallback. Do not rerun the same parser candidate or LibreDWG JSON screen absent a changed source or tool.
disposition.P5A: Not activated from this sample; actual table-to-field relationships, physical links, and known field values were not established.

nextEvidence: Obtain an independent decode exposing the exact decoded TABLE object-body cursor/field span, or a version-qualified Autodesk/ObjectARX trace for these cells. Otherwise retain the current fail-closed semantic disposition and work other admitted profiles.
